description: Fig. 11 is an eight-panel composite of SEM fractographs of tensile-tested specimens of a high (~5%) Al-added low-density medium-Mn steel. Panels are lettered (a)-(h) in yellow, each with its own scale bar and coloured annotations: yellow dashed outlines, red and yellow arrows, and red italic "δ" labels. (a) HRQ, 20 µm bar, and (b) HRQ, 4 µm bar, show rough faceted surfaces annotated "Cleavage/flat facet" with red arrows. (c) IA750_5 Min, 10 µm bar, shows a large flat facet (red arrow, "Cleavage/ flat facet") beside a yellow-dashed "Quasi-cleavage" region, with δ ferrite labelled. (d) IA750_30 Min (10 µm), (e) IA750_60 Min (30 µm), (f) IA750_60 Min (10 µm), (g) IA750_120 Min (10 µm) and (h) IA750_180 Min (5 µm) show yellow-dashed quasi-cleavage regions; (f) additionally shows a large red-dashed area containing yellow-dashed "dimples" labelled as ductile tearing. Apart from scale bars, no numeric values are printed on any panel. The sequence shows that the quenched state fractures predominantly by cleavage/flat facets, while intercritical annealing at 750 °C progressively replaces cleavage facets by quasi-cleavage, δ-ferrite regions and dimpled ductile areas.

observations.observation: Panels (a) and (b) of the HRQ specimen carry yellow text "Cleavage/flat facet" with red arrows pointing to flat, stepped transgranular facets.
Scale bars printed on the panels are: (a) 20 µm, (b) 4 µm, (c) 10 µm, (d) 10 µm, (e) 30 µm, (f) 10 µm, (g) 10 µm, (h) 5 µm.
Panel (c) shows both a red-arrowed "Cleavage/ flat facet" area and a yellow-dashed "Quasi-cleavage" area, and bears a red "δ" (ferrite) label.
Panel (f) contains a red-dashed outlined region labelled "Quasi-cleavage" enclosing two yellow-dashed zones labelled "dimples".
Red "δ" labels appear in panels (c), (d), (e), (g) and (h); yellow-dashed quasi-cleavage outlines appear in (c)-(h).
No numerical data values (strength, strain, fraction) are printed on any panel; only scale bars and text annotations are present.

The caption assigns panels as: (a, b) hot rolled & quenched (HRQ); (c) intercritical annealed at 750 °C for 5 minutes; (d) 30 minutes; (e, f) 60 minutes; (g) 120 minutes; and repeats "(g)" for 180 minutes, so the 180-minute panel is the one lettered (h).
The caption states that the red arrow indicates cleavage/flat facet mode fracture.
The citing text states the HRQ specimen fracture surface exhibits mainly cleavage and/or flat facets, representing a brittle mode of failure.

The citing text states that in IA750_5 Min, δ ferrite shows cleavage-mode fracture while the retained (untransformed + reverted) austenite outlined by the yellow dashed line shows quasi-cleavage fracture.
The citing text states similar quasi-cleavage fracture surfaces were observed in IA750_30 Min, IA750_60 Min, IA750_120 Min and IA750_180 Min (Fig. 11d-h).
The citing text attributes dimples to reverted austenite (ductile mode) and states that the major portion of the fracture surface is cleavage due to the high fraction of δ-ferrite.

subfigures.description: HRQ specimen, low-magnification SEM fractograph (20 µm scale bar): rough, blocky fracture surface with large flat facets and secondary cracks; two red arrows mark cleavage/flat-facet areas.
HRQ specimen at higher magnification (4 µm scale bar): clearly stepped transgranular flat facets annotated "Cleavage/flat facet" in yellow with a red arrow.
IA750_5 Min (10 µm scale bar): a large flat facet marked "Cleavage/ flat facet" with a red arrow, adjacent to a yellow-dashed elongated region labelled "Quasi-cleavage"; red "δ" marks ferrite.
IA750_30 Min (10 µm scale bar, blue): several yellow-dashed elongated ridges labelled "Quasi-cleavage", a red "δ" label and a red arrow; small white glyph "b" near the scale bar.
IA750_60 Min (30 µm scale bar, blue): mixed surface with small yellow-dashed "Quasi-cleavage" patches, two red "δ" labels and red arrows pointing to brittle-looking areas.
IA750_60 Min (10 µm scale bar, blue): a red-dashed outlined region labelled "Quasi-cleavage" containing two yellow-dashed areas labelled "dimples", i.e. ductile tearing features.
IA750_120 Min (10 µm scale bar): long yellow-dashed rounded ridges labelled "Quasi-cleavage", red "δ" labels and a red arrow.
IA750_180 Min (5 µm scale bar): a yellow-dashed elongated feature labelled "Quasi-cleavage" in a flat cleavage-like matrix, with a red "δ" label and red arrow.

unreadable_items: panel (d): a small white glyph "b" next to the blue 10 µm scale bar cannot be related to any annotation and may be a rendering artefact
